question: Sound waves and seismic P-waves are examples of which type of waves?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Longitudinal waves__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Longitudinal waves** are waves in which the vibration of the medium is parallel to the direction in the wave travels and the displacement of the medium is in the same direction of the wave propagation.
